QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member
#endif` and "Without the opt-out, `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ctx->private_state`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro definition and states that by default it renames to private_<member>, while defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS leaves the member name unchanged.
